Markets.title: CAS weighs on derivatives volumes, raising financial markets concerns
Markets.summary: Equity derivatives trading volume on the NSE and BSE dropped to multi-month lows in August. Analysts attribute this decline to the new Closing Auction Session, which has prompted traders to exit positions earlier to avoid risks.

Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as oil, yields raise September jitters
Markets.summary: US stocks fell to start September due to rising oil prices and Treasury yields that heightened inflation and rate concerns. Markets are now pricing in a 68.2% chance of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike this month.

Markets.title: FCNR rush leaves banks swimming in ₹6.65 lakh crore liquidity
Markets.summary: Inflows from FCNR(B) deposits have pushed banking system liquidity to a four-year high, driving the weighted average call rate well below the repo rate. Banks are parking this excess cash in short-term variable rate reverse repo operations with the RBI.

Markets.title: No more hush-hush: Tax portal opens door to misconduct complaints
Markets.summary: The Income Tax portal now features a secure digital tab allowing taxpayers to report officer misconduct, including bribery and sexual harassment. Tax professionals emphasize that the success of this confidential reporting mechanism depends on prompt resolution and effective oversight.

Markets.title: Coal India bets ₹50,000 crore on life beyond coal; goes big on gasification, critical minerals
Markets.summary: Coal India is investing nearly ₹50,000 crore in coal gasification, renewable energy, and overseas critical mineral assets like lithium. These initiatives aim to reduce import dependence and drive future growth beyond traditional coal mining.

Markets.title: India’s August fuel story: Petrol, diesel up, LPG down sharply
Markets.summary: In August, India's sales of petrol, diesel, and aviation turbine fuel increased due to higher mobility and economic growth. Conversely, cooking gas consumption dropped sharply as users shifted to piped natural gas.

Geo-Political.title: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
Geo-Political.summary: Germany stated that Russia was responsible for a drone carrying an explosive device that was found near Ukrainian cargo planes at Leipzig airport on August 4. German authorities confirmed the drone attack plot was orchestrated by Russian operatives.

Geo-Political.title: Iran retaliates after US strikes kills four at wedding party, state media reports
Geo-Political.summary: Iran launched retaliatory missile and drone attacks on United States targets following a U.S. strike that killed four people at a wedding party. State media reported that the military operations had already begun.

Geo-Political.title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
Geo-Political.summary: As of August, Pakistan and Iran have deported one million people to Afghanistan this year. Many of these returnees have never lived in the country and now face starting over under Taliban rule.

Geo-Political.title: River water smashed into tunnel and chased me for 20 minutes, Nepal worker tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Rescue operations are ongoing in Nepal as the country's death toll surpasses 1,000 following a major disaster. A surviving hydropower worker told the BBC that river water smashed into a tunnel and chased him for 20 minutes.

Geo-Political.title: Sexual assaults happening almost every day in Ceuta, prosecutors say
Geo-Political.summary: Prosecutors report that sexual assaults are occurring almost daily in the Spanish exclave of Ceuta. This follows an influx of migrants, of whom approximately 5,000 currently remain while most others have returned to Morocco.

Geo-Political.title: Jurors in Lindsay Clancy trial deadlocked but judge asks them to keep trying
Geo-Political.summary: A Massachusetts jury is currently deadlocked in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, who faces murder charges for the 2023 deaths of her three children. The judge has instructed the jurors to continue their deliberations.

AI & Tech.summary: An author found their WordPress course recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best SaaS building course. They achieved this free visibility without paying for advertising.

Data & Insights.title: Fed Governor Michael Barr draws a line on inflation, backs rate hike if price pressures persist
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr stated the central bank must increase interest rates if inflation does not return to its two percent target. He emphasized that additional policy tightening is necessary if persistent price pressures continue.

Data & Insights.title: India's current account widens marginally in April-June, RBI data shows
Data & Insights.summary: India's current account deficit increased slightly during the April-to-June quarter compared to the previous year. The Reserve Bank of India reported that this widening was driven by higher commodity prices and a larger trade gap.

Data & Insights.title: Russia cuts expected 2026 oil output to 17-year low, says report; what it means for India
Data & Insights.summary: Russia has reduced its projected 2026 oil output to a 17-year low amid increasing crude exports. This shift highlights India's growing role as a primary buyer in Moscow's key Asian oil market.

Data & Insights.title: Centre slashes sugar dealers’ stock limit to 2,000 quintals from 15 September
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has reduced the stock limit for sugar dealers to 2,000 quintals starting September 15. This measure aims to maintain adequate domestic sugar supplies and stable prices ahead of the festive season.

Data & Insights.title: Q1 GDP growth beats expectations: Are foreign investors underestimating India's resilience?
Data & Insights.summary: India's Q1 GDP grew by a better-than-expected 7.8%, driven by strong investment and fiscal improvements. This resilient economic performance defied foreign skepticism despite ongoing geopolitical tensions and oil price concerns.

Data & Insights.title: GST collections rise 14.8% to  ₹1.99 trillion in August; refunds jump 68%
Data & Insights.summary: India's Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections rose 14.8% year-on-year to ₹1.99 trillion in August, while refunds jumped 68%. Despite this annual growth, August collections were lower than the ₹2.11 trillion recorded in July.

India.title: Truck Drivers Halt Traffic, Allege Harassment Amid Assam-Mizoram Dispute
India.summary: Mizoram-bound truck drivers continued a protest on the Assam side of a highway for the third day on Tuesday. The drivers halted traffic to allege harassment amid the ongoing Assam-Mizoram border dispute.

India.title: Drug Crackdown Backfires? Punjab Cop, Sister Attacked In Gurdaspur
India.summary: A Punjab constable and his sister were attacked in Gurdaspur. The constable alleged the assault happened because he had previously reported local drug peddlers to the police.

India.title: Faridabad Girl, Punished In School Over Biryani Fight, Dies By Suicide
India.summary: A girl in Faridabad died by suicide on Tuesday after being punished at Navodaya Vidya Niketan Senior Secondary School. The punishment followed a fight involving biryani at the school.

India.title: Gujarat Flies Global As Ahmedabad Airport Adopts Seamless Hub And Spoke Model
India.summary: Ahmedabad Airport has adopted a hub-and-spoke model to improve global connectivity and passenger transit. This initiative aligns with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's vision to upgrade Indian civil aviation and expand air accessibility.

India.title: 7 Letters To Punjab Police, Yet No FIR In 'Transfer Racket' Case: Probe Agency ED Tells Court
India.summary: The Enforcement Directorate informed a court that the Punjab Police failed to file an FIR despite receiving seven letters regarding a transfer and posting racket. The agency alleges that Rajbir Singh Ghuman, an aide of Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, led the corruption scheme involving IAS and IPS officers.

India.title: Delhi Voter List Revision: Tughlakabad Tops Missing List, Okhla Second
India.summary: Tughlakabad recorded the highest number of missing voters in Delhi's voter list revision with 92,033 uncollected enumeration forms. Okhla ranked second, with 45.16 percent of its electorate, or 1,63,829 voters, missing from the list.

General.title: Burnham promises more devolution and public control of essential services
General.summary: Andy Burnham addressed MPs as Prime Minister, promising increased devolution and public control of essential services. Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch criticized the plan, stating it would lead to more government control, higher taxes, and additional politicians.

General.title: UK long-term borrowing costs highest since 1998 ahead of October Budget
General.summary: UK long-term borrowing costs have reached their highest level since 1998. This creates increased financial pressure ahead of the upcoming October Budget.

General.title: Charlie Kirk murder suspect pleads not guilty as judge clears way for death penalty trial
General.summary: Tyler Robinson pleaded not guilty to the aggravated murder of Charlie Kirk and six other charges in Utah. The judge's ruling clears the way for a potential death penalty trial.

General.title: Rising numbers of children in mental health crisis ending up in A&E
General.summary: NHS emergency departments are seeing more cases of self-harm, eating disorders and emotional distress in young people.

General.title: Iran retaliates after US strikes kills four at wedding party, state media reports
General.summary: Iran launched retaliatory missile and drone attacks against U.S. targets. State media reported the strikes occurred after a U.S. attack killed four people at a wedding party.

General.title: Tiger Woods to change plea after crash arrest
General.summary: Tiger Woods plans to change his plea during a court hearing on Wednesday. The golfer was previously charged with driving under the influence following a crash arrest.
